chunks: And with this chain, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abdillah ibn Sinan al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the prayer of the two Eids, is there a prayer before them or after them? He said: There is nothing before them and nothing after them.

key_terms.صَلَاهِ الْعِيدَيْنِ: The two Eid prayers (Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha)

ai.seo_question: Are there specific prayers before or after the Eid prayer in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Thawab al-A'mal*, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) clarifies the legal status of the Eid prayers by confirming the absence of specific *mustahabb* prayers immediately preceding or following the main congregational prayer. This ruling underscores the distinct, self-contained nature of the Eid prayer within Shia jurisprudence, distinguishing it from other daily prayers that often have attached sunnah or nafl units. The emphasis on the lack of adjacent prayers highlights the unique ritual completeness of the Eid celebration as a standalone act of worship.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 4. And from the previous chain from al-Hussain b. Sa’eed from Muhammad b. Sinan from Abdillah b. Sinan al-Halabi from Abi Abdillah (a.s.)
who said: The narrator asked Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.), “Is there any Salaat before or after the Salaat of Eid-ul-Fitr and Eid-e- Qurban?” Imam (a.s.) replied, “No, neither before nor after.”
